Last post here was December 2023. Long time.

Honest version of why: writing felt like extra work on top of the actual learning. Turns out you have to write to learn the thing properly, so I'm back.

What I'm spending time on right now:

- Model distillation.
- Agent RL and agentic workflows.
- Math Academy in the background, daily.

I'm not going to promise a posting cadence. The bar is "write when there's something honest to say about what I'm doing." If you want updates without checking back, the [RSS feed](/index.xml) is the way.
